schema.name: SendMessage
schema.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

to.description: Recipient: a name from ListAgents (append its " [ref]" only when a listing or an error shows one), a teammate name, "main", or a background agent's agentId

summary.description: A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row (not transmitted — the recipient previews the first line of `message`). Truncated to 200 characters rather than rejected.

message.description: Plain text message content. The recipient's human sees only the FIRST LINE as a one-line preview until they expand it, so make the first line a clear, self-contained sentence saying what this is about — not a greeting, preamble, or bare @-mention.

notify_when_idle.description: Ask a session ON THIS MACHINE to send you ONE notice when it next goes idle (finishes its turn with nothing queued) or exits — opt-in, one-shot, no polling. With a message: deliver it now AND subscribe. Without a message (omit it): a pure subscription that costs the other session nothing.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.description:
IMPORTANT: WebFetch WILL FAIL for authenticated or private URLs. Before using this tool, check if the URL points to an authenticated service (e.g. Google Docs, Confluence, Jira, GitHub). If so, look for a specialized MCP tool that provides authenticated access.

- Fetches content from a specified URL and processes it using an AI model
- Takes a URL and a prompt as input
- Fetches the URL content, converts HTML to markdown
- Processes the content with the prompt using a small, fast model
- Returns the model's response about the content
- Use this tool when you need to retrieve and analyze web content

Usage notes:
  - IMPORTANT: If an MCP-provided web fetch tool is available, prefer using that tool instead of this one, as it may have fewer restrictions.
  - The URL must be a fully-formed valid URL
  - HTTP URLs will be automatically upgraded to HTTPS
  - localhost and other hostnames without a dot are not supported; for a local server, use curl via Bash
  - The prompt should describe what information you want to extract from the page
  - This tool is read-only and does not modify any files
  - Results may be summarized if the content is very large
  - Includes a self-cleaning cache (entries expire after 15 minutes) for faster responses when repeatedly accessing the same URL
  - When a URL redirects to a different host, the tool will inform you and provide the redirect URL in a special format. You should then make a new WebFetch request with the redirect URL to fetch the content.
  - For GitHub URLs, prefer using the gh CLI via Bash instead (e.g., gh pr view, gh issue view, gh api).

import os
from ament_index_python.packages import get_package_share_directory
from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch_ros.actions import LifecycleNode, Node
from launch_ros.event_handlers import OnStateTransition
from launch_ros.events.lifecycle import ChangeState
from launch.actions import DeclareLaunchArgument, RegisterEventHandler, EmitEvent
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch_ros.parameter_descriptions import ParameterValue
import lifecycle_msgs.msg

def generate_launch_description():
    # 可覆盖参数，默认值与改动前保持一致，不影响本机开发
    serial_device = LaunchConfiguration('serial_device')
    health_rate_hz = LaunchConfiguration('health_rate_hz')

    declared_arguments = [
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            'serial_device',
            default_value='/dev/ttyUSB0',
            description='底盘串口设备路径（服务器部署时由入口脚本传入 PTY 路径）',
        ),
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            'health_rate_hz',
            default_value='2.0',
            description='底盘链路健康/心跳发布频率。安全门的 heartbeat_timeout_ms '
                        '默认 500ms，部署时应传入 ≥5.0 以避免"心跳间隔 == 超时阈值"'
                        '导致的看门狗误触发。',
        ),
    ]

    dispatcher_node = LifecycleNode(
        package='amr_dispatcher_ros',
        executable='dispatcher_node',
        name='dispatcher_node',
        namespace='',
        output='screen',
        parameters=[{
            'queue_capacity': 128,
            'comparator': 'priority_fifo',
            'schedule_rate_hz': 10.0,
            'deadlock_check_rate_hz': 1.0,
            'max_active_missions': 4,
            'stations_file': 'config/stations.yaml',
        }]
    )

    # 声明自动触发 configure 事件
    configure_event = EmitEvent(
        event=ChangeState(
            lifecycle_node_matcher=lambda node: node == dispatcher_node,
            transition_id=lifecycle_msgs.msg.Transition.TRANSITION_CONFIGURE,
        )
    )

    # 当 configure 成功后自动触发 activate 事件
    activate_event = RegisterEventHandler(
        OnStateTransition(
            target_lifecycle_node=dispatcher_node,
            goal_state='inactive',
            entities=[
                EmitEvent(
                    event=ChangeState(
                        lifecycle_node_matcher=lambda node: node == dispatcher_node,
                        transition_id=lifecycle_msgs.msg.Transition.TRANSITION_ACTIVATE,
                    )
                )
            ],
        )
    )

    safety_gate_node = Node(
        package='amr_dispatcher_ros',
        executable='safety_gate_node',
        name='safety_gate_node',
        output='screen',
        parameters=[{
            'max_linear_x_mps': 1.5,
            'max_linear_y_mps': 1.0,
            'max_angular_z_radps': 2.0,
            'heartbeat_timeout_ms': 500,
            'soft_timeout_ms': 2000,
        }]
    )

    chassis_driver_node = Node(
        package='amr_dispatcher_ros',
        executable='chassis_driver_node',
        name='chassis_driver_node',
        output='screen',
        parameters=[{
            'serial_device': serial_device,
            'serial_baud': 115200,
            'odom_frame_id': 'odom',
            'base_frame_id': 'base_link',
            'publish_tf': True,
            'poll_rate_hz': 50.0,
            # LaunchConfiguration 产出字符串，需显式声明为 double 以免参数类型不匹配
            'health_rate_hz': ParameterValue(health_rate_hz, value_type=float),
        }]
    )

    path_tracker_node = Node(
        package='amr_dispatcher_ros',
        executable='path_tracker_node',
        name='path_tracker_node',
        output='screen',
        parameters=[{
            'controller_type': 'pure_pursuit',
            'lookahead_distance': 0.6,
            'target_speed': 0.5,
            'control_rate_hz': 20.0,
        }]
    )

    rest_gateway_node = Node(
        package='amr_dispatcher_tools',
        executable='rest_gateway',
        name='rest_gateway_node',
        output='screen',
        parameters=[{'port': 8080}]
    )

    dispatcher_visualizer_node = Node(
        package='amr_dispatcher_ros',
        executable='dispatcher_visualizer_node',
        name='dispatcher_visualizer_node',
        output='screen',
        parameters=[{
            'frame_id': 'map',
            'marker_topic': '/dispatcher/markers',
            'stations_file': 'config/stations.yaml'
        }]
    )

    lifecycle_coordinator_node = Node(
        package='amr_dispatcher_ros',
        executable='lifecycle_coordinator_node',
        name='lifecycle_coordinator_node',
        output='screen',
        parameters=[{
            'auto_bringup': True,
            'check_period_ms': 500
        }]
    )

    return LaunchDescription(declared_arguments + [
        dispatcher_node,
        configure_event,
        activate_event,
        safety_gate_node,
        chassis_driver_node,
        path_tracker_node,
        rest_gateway_node,
        dispatcher_visualizer_node,
        lifecycle_coordinator_node,
    ])

                    )

    safety_gate_node = Node(
        package='amr_dispatcher_ros',
        executable='safety_gate_node',
        name='safety_gate_node',
        output='screen',
        parameters=[{
            'max_linear_x_mps': 1.5,
            'max_linear_y_mps': 1.0,
            'max_angular_z_radps': 2.0,
            'heartbeat_timeout_ms': 500,
            'soft_timeout_ms': 2000,
        }]
    )

    chassis_driver_node = Node(
        package='amr_dispatcher_ros',
        executable='chassis_driver_node',
        name='chassis_driver_node',
        output='screen',
        parameters=[{
            'serial_device': serial_device,
            'serial_baud': 115200,

            'base_frame_id': 'base_link',
            'publish_tf': True,
            'poll_rate_hz': 50.0,

            'health_rate_hz': ParameterValue(health_rate_hz, value_type=float),
        }]
    )

    path_tracker_node = Node(
        package='amr_dispatcher_ros',
        executable='path_tracker_node',
        name='path_tracker_node',
        output='screen',
        parameters=[{
            'controller_type': 'pure_pursuit',
            'lookahead_distance': 0.6,
            'target_speed': 0.5,
            'control_rate_hz': 20.0,
        }]
    )

    rest_gateway_node = Node(
        package='amr_dispatcher_tools',
        executable='rest_gateway',
        name='rest_gateway_node',
        output='screen',
        parameters=[{'port': 8080}]
    )

    dispatcher_visualizer_node = Node(
        package='amr_dispatcher_ros',
        executable='dispatcher_visualizer_node',
        name='dispatcher_visualizer_node',
        output='screen',
        parameters=[{
            'frame_id': 'map',
            'marker_topic': '/dispatcher/markers',
            'stations_file': 'config/stations.yaml'
        }]
    )

    lifecycle_coordinator_node = Node(
        package='amr_dispatcher_ros',
        executable='lifecycle_coordinator_node',
        name='lifecycle_coordinator_node',
        output='screen',
        parameters=[{
            'auto_bringup': True,
            'check_period_ms': 500
        }]
    )

    return LaunchDescription(declared_arguments + [
        dispatcher_node,
        configure_event,
        activate_event,
        safety_gate_node,
        chassis_driver_node,
        path_tracker_node,
        rest_gateway_node,
        dispatcher_visualizer_node,
        lifecycle_coordinator_node,
    ])

# ROS 2 集成层代码审查报告（amr_dispatcher）

审查范围：`src/amr_dispatcher_ros/`、`src/amr_dispatcher_interfaces/`、`src/amr_dispatcher_bt/`、`launch/`、`config/`、`test/l2_launch_contracts`、`test/integration`。共 15 条发现，按严重程度排序。

## 高危

### H1. 安全链无"零速兜底"——上游静默/崩溃时底盘持续执行最后一帧非零速度
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/src/safety_gate_node.cpp:171-194`（`/cmd_vel_safe` 唯一发布点在 L191）、`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/src/chassis_driver_node.cpp:66-85`
- **问题**：safety_gate 只有在收到 `/cmd_vel_raw` 消息时才 Evaluate 并发布 `/cmd_vel_safe`；看门狗定时器（L94-96，100ms tick）检测到心跳超时后仅向 FaultSupervisor 推事件（L134-169），**从不发布零速停车指令**。estop/bumper 回调（L98-125）同样只推事件。chassis_driver 的 `CmdVelCallback` 只在收到消息时写串口，`ReadPollLoop`（L86 起）只读不写，**无指令超时置零**。
- **为什么是问题**：path_tracker 崩溃、静默或到达后停发 `/cmd_vel_raw`（`path_tracker_node.cpp:125-128`，`has_path_=false` 后停发且无最后零速帧）时，safety_gate 与 chassis 均无软件停机路径，底盘固件若无自带超时（存疑）将无限延续最后的非零命令。与 README.md:41-42 宣称的 "Independent 50Hz safety gate / Watchdog Timeout (200ms) shutdown" 直接矛盾。
- **修复建议**：safety_gate 增加由看门狗驱动的发布循环（>timeout 未收到 raw 即周期发布零速）；chassis_driver 在 `ReadPollLoop` 中加指令年龄检查，超时主动写零速。

### H2. 心跳主题共用使看门狗形同虚设
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/src/safety_gate_node.cpp:127-132`；`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/src/chassis_driver_node.cpp:47,172-208`；`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/src/path_tracker_node.cpp:80-83,119-123`
- **问题**：chassis_driver 与 path_tracker 都往同一主题 `/safety/heartbeat` 发无来源标识的 `std_msgs/Bool`；safety_gate 的 `WatchdogHeartbeatCallback` 收到**任一**消息就同时 `FeedHeartbeat("path_tracker")` 和 `FeedHeartbeat("chassis_driver")`。chassis 以 `health_rate_hz`（默认 2Hz）无条件发布心跳，使 path_tracker 的看门狗永不失效。反向叠加：path_tracker 的心跳发布在 ControlLoop 的空闲早退（L80-83）**之后**（L119-123），空闲时从不发心跳——这个"失联"又被 chassis 的心跳掩盖。watchdog 实际只能检测"两节点同时沉默"。
- **修复建议**：每节点独立心跳主题，或心跳消息带 `source` 字段、回调按发布者分别 Feed；path_tracker 心跳应无条件周期发布。

## 中危

### M1. navigate_sequence_bridge_node 没有任何 launch 文件启动
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/launch/full_system.launch.py:145-157`（启动清单缺 bridge）；bridge 仅在 `/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/scripts/check_navigate_sequence_bridge.sh:141` 被手动运行
- **问题**：dispatcher 在 `navigation_backend: action` 时向 `/navigate_sequence` 发 goal（`dispatcher_node.cpp:152`）。全仓 `launch/` 目录 grep 不到 bridge 节点。action 模式下 dispatcher 派发前检查 `action_server_is_ready()` 失败即判负（`dispatcher_node.cpp:1208-1211`）——即任何 launch 起的系统在 action 后端下**每单必失败**。
- **修复建议**：在 full_system（及 bridge 可用的组合）中加入 `navigate_sequence_bridge_node`。

### M2. bringup 心跳参数自承"间隔==超时"悖论但默认值未修
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/launch/full_system.launch.py:24-30`（描述明写部署应传 ≥5.0），L25 `default_value='2.0'`；L81 `'heartbeat_timeout_ms': 500`
- **问题**：launch 自己的参数描述承认 2Hz 心跳（500ms 间隔）与安全门 500ms 超时阈值相等会误触发看门狗，但默认值仍保留 2.0。时钟抖动下 `/system/ready` 与看门狗会在误报/漏报边界抖动。`chassis_driver_node.cpp:22` 默认 `health_rate_hz` 也是 2.0。
- **修复建议**：默认 ≥5Hz，或 `heartbeat_timeout_ms` ≥ 1000。

### M3. on_cleanup 直接 clear 在途 action goal，不 abort/终止
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/src/dispatcher_node.cpp:231`（`execute_goal_handles_.clear();`）
- **问题**：`on_cleanup` 重置 action server 与句柄时对在途 goal 直接 clear，不调用 `abort()`。rclcpp_action 语义下 goal handle 析构时客户端既收不到 SUCCEEDED/ABORTED/CANCELED 也收不到终态结果，客户端悬挂。`HandleGoal` 阶段已 `Reserve` 的路由锁（L741）依赖后续表重建释放，路径脆弱。
- **修复建议**：cleanup 前遍历 `execute_goal_handles_` 逐个 `abort()`（并释放对应 reservation），再清空。

### M4. README 宣称的"参数热重载"不存在
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/include/amr_dispatcher_ros/dispatcher_node.hpp:278`（`param_callback_handle_` 声明后从未赋值）；全仓 `src/amr_dispatcher_ros/src` 无任何 `add_on_set_parameters_callback`
- **问题**：README.md:64 宣称 "Dynamic Parameter Hot-Reload (EDF / FIFO)"，但参数仅在 on_configure/on_activate 一次性读取，运行时 `ros2 param set` 无效。`param_callback_handle_` 是残留死声明。
- **修复建议**：实现参数回调（比较器、rate 等热切换需线程安全），或删除 README 声称与死成员。

### M5. 10 棵行为树中 5 棵运行时从未加载
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/include/amr_dispatcher_ros/dispatcher_node.hpp:55-59`（只 include recovery/result/runtime/queued_mission_start/submit_order 5 棵）；`TickStationSequence|TickDocking|TickFacility|TickMissionQueue|TickMissionResourceCleanup` 在 `src/amr_dispatcher_ros|launch|tools` 零命中
- **问题**：docking、facility、mission_queue、mission_resource_cleanup、station_sequence 5 棵树仅在 `src/amr_dispatcher_bt/test` 有单测覆盖，生产链路从未调用。README "10 棵树 36/36 测试" 会让人误以为全部编排已接线。
- **修复建议**：在 dispatcher 节点接线缺失的树，或文档明确区分"已接入"与"仅算法验证"。

### M6. /v2 服务大面积 stub 且绝大多数无程序化调用方
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/src/dispatcher_node.cpp`
  - `EstimateMissionCostCb` L588-600：distance=10.0、waypoint_count=2 硬编码
  - `ListStationsCb` L649-659：4 个硬编码站点，不读 stations catalog
  - `ValidateSiteConfigCb` L710-718：恒 success，声称 checked stations.yaml/dispatcher.yaml 但两者都不读
  - `PreemptMissionCb` L552-572：只入高优队列，不抢占活动任务（语义名不副实）
  - `ReserveFacilityResourceCb` L679-693：复用交通 reservation_table_ 做"设施"预留，无配套设施释放服务
- **调用方核查**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_tools/src/rest_gateway.cpp:42-44` 只调 `/dispatcher/submit_order`、`/dispatcher/cancel_order`、`/system/ready`；其余 9 个 `/v2/*` 服务只有 USAGE.md 手工 `ros2 service call` 示例，无真实调用方。
- **修复建议**：stub 实现真实逻辑或在接口/README 标注 experimental；设施预留补 release 路径。

### M7. config/*.yaml（除 stations.yaml）无任何代码或 launch 读取
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/config/dispatcher.yaml`、`safety.yaml`、`chassis.yaml` 等；launch 全部内联参数（如 `full_system.launch.py:38-46`、`core_only.launch.py:15-23`）
- **问题**：grep 证实除 stations.yaml（经 `stations_file` 参数）外没有任何 yaml 被读取；dispatcher.yaml 的嵌套 `dispatcher:` 键也不是合法 ROS params 格式。且内联值已与 yaml 漂移（如 `max_active_missions`：full_system=4、core_only=2）。用户改 config 不生效。dispatcher_node.cpp:716 的 validate 检查声明进一步误导。
- **修复建议**：launch 用 `parameters=[yaml路径]` 引用这些文件（转为合法格式），或删除无人读取的 yaml。

### M8. L2 launch 契约测试未接入构建，且断言为空壳
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/test/l2_launch_contracts/test_lifecycle_contracts.py:29-33`（`sleep(1.0)` + `assertTrue(True)`）；全仓 CMakeLists.txt/package.xml 无 `launch_testing` 引用
- **问题**：文件头声称 "Verifies topic emission, service availability, and state transitions"，实际只验证进程存活；且从未被任何包注册，**根本不会运行**。`scripts/check_all.sh:63-71` 却报告 "L2_node_contracts VERIFIED, framework: ROS 2 launch_testing"。`test/integration/test_end_to_end_pipeline.cpp` 虽经 `src/amr_dispatcher_core/CMakeLists.txt:162` 接入，但它是纯核心算法模拟，不启动任何 ROS 节点，名为 end-to_end 容易误导。
- **修复建议**：为 l2 测试建 test 包并注册 launch_testing；把断言补成真实契约检查，否则降级声明。

### M9. 桥接节点单航点时覆盖目标 yaw
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/src/navigate_sequence_bridge_node.cpp:103-115`；对照 `/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/src/dispatcher_node.cpp:1213-1223`
- **问题**：dispatcher action 模式恰发送 1 个航点并按 `wp.theta` 设好四元数；bridge 预处理 `double yaw = 0.0; if (n > 1) {...}` 后在 L113-114 **无条件**用计算出的 yaw（单航点时为 0）重写 `orientation.z/w`，目标站点朝向丢失，机器人到场后朝向错误。
- **修复建议**：`if (n > 1)` 分支内才覆盖 orientation，单航点保留原始四元数。

### M10. 任务 id 与 sequence 永远差一
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/src/dispatcher_node.cpp:469-472`（Enqueue）、L562-565（Preempt）、L1491-1496（dock）；对照 L289-296（SubmitOrder 用法又不同）
- **问题**：`m.id = "m_" + std::to_string(next_sequence_++); ... m.sequence = next_sequence_;`——id 用旧值、sequence 用新值，两者恒差 1；SubmitOrder 则 id 用当前值、sequence 用 `next_sequence_++`，三处行为互不一致。按 id 做日志关联、按 sequence 排队会得出对不上的序号。
- **修复建议**：统一为 `auto n = next_sequence_++; m.id = "m_" + std::to_string(n); m.sequence = n;`。

## 低危

### L1. 反馈/状态消息多个字段恒零或语义失真
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/src/dispatcher_node.cpp:1016,1719`（`estimated_remaining_sec = 0.0`）；`dispatcher_node.cpp:1716`（周期反馈 `state_code` 恒 1 WAITING_LOCK——plan（topic）模式下无任何来源发 state_code=2，action 模式靠 NavFeedbackCb L1003-1009 补）；`DispatcherState.msg:6` `paused_missions_count` 全仓从未赋值恒 0；`TrackingError.msg` 的 `lookahead_distance_m`、`actual_angular_z_radps` 在 `path_tracker_node.cpp:90-110` 从不赋值
- **修复建议**：plan 模式补 EXECUTING 状态映射、实现 ETA/暂停计数，或从接口删除永不填充的字段。

### L2. lifecycle_coordinator 声称级联管理 4 节点，实际只管 dispatcher
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/src/lifecycle_coordinator_node.cpp:21-24`（注释：ChassisDriver→SafetyGate→PathTracker→DispatcherNode 级联）vs L35-38（仅创建 dispatcher_node 的 GetState/ChangeState client）
- **问题**：chassis/safety_gate/path_tracker 都是普通 Node 不走生命周期，注释与实现不符；另 L62 发布的 `/system/ready_flag`（transient_local）全仓无订阅方。
- **修复建议**：修正注释或实现真正的多节点级联；删除/接入 ready_flag。

### L3. core_only.launch.py 起的 dispatcher 永远停在 unconfigured
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/launch/core_only.launch.py:10-23`（LifecycleNode 无 configure/activate 事件，也无 lifecycle_coordinator）；对照 `full_system.launch.py:52-77` 有完整事件链
- **问题**：dispatcher 的服务/发布器/action server 全在 `on_configure`（`dispatcher_node.cpp:33-159`）创建，core_only 下不会出现，除非用户手动 `ros2 lifecycle set`。名"core_only"但核心接口全缺。
- **修复建议**：给 core_only 补 configure/activate 事件或加 coordinator。

### L4. 相对路径 stations_file 依赖进程 cwd
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/launch/full_system.launch.py:44,132`（`'config/stations.yaml'`）
- **问题**：dispatcher 与 visualizer 均依赖启动时的工作目录；`docker/entrypoint.server.sh` 头部注释自承必须 cd 到工作区根否则 visualizer 加载失败。从其它目录 `ros2 launch` 即失败。
- **修复建议**：launch 内用 `get_package_share_directory('amr_dispatcher_ros')` 拼绝对路径并 install config 目录（当前 `src/amr_dispatcher_ros/CMakeLists.txt` 只 install include 与 xml，未 install launch/config——launch 文件本身也未被任何包 install，`ros2 launch amr_dispatcher_ros xxx.py` 不可用，只能按路径调用）。

### L5. ros2_control.launch.py 缺 robot_description，无 URDF
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/launch/ros2_control.launch.py:5-12`（`parameters=[]`）；全仓无 urdf/xacro、无 controllers yaml
- **问题**：`ros2_control_node` 无 robot_description 参数无法启动；spawner 引用的 `diff_drive_base_controller`/`joint_state_broadcaster` 无配置文件。存疑该 launch 是否可用。
- **修复建议**：补 URDF + ros2_control + controllers 配置，或移除该 launch。

### L6. DeadlockTick kRetry 向可能不存在的 mission 写 map
- **位置**：`/home/ubuntu/个人学习/amr_dispatcher/src/amr_dispatcher_ros/src/dispatcher_node.cpp:1650-1651`
- **问题**：对可能已不在 `active_missions_` 的 mission_id 写入 `mission_attempts_`/`mission_last_progress_`，长期运行缓慢泄漏条目。
- **修复建议**：写入前确认 mission 存在，或定期裁剪失效键。

---

**备注**：多线程 executor 场景下 `active_missions_mutex_` 存在有锁/无锁混用（如 `dispatcher_node.cpp:349-364,728,926-941,1179` 无锁 vs L630,702,978 有锁），但当前 `main()` 为单线程 `spin`（L1750-1756），现网无害；若未来换 MultiThreadedExecutor 需先补锁（存疑性提示，未计入编号）。bridge 无到达超时兜底是否由死锁检测 kCancel 覆盖，存疑。
